name: vrlbry
description: A candle-lit 3D library for Kiwix ZIM files: walk the shelves and read Project Gutenberg, Wikipedia and Wikisource in VR (Meta Quest), on a desktop or a phone.

paragraphs: A virtual library for your ZIM files. vrlbry finds the .zim files in a folder and shelves their books in a warm, candle-lit 3D reading room. Walk up to a shelf, pull a book out, look at its cover, open it and read it page by page. It works in a VR headset (Meta Quest and other WebXR browsers), on a desktop with mouse and keyboard, and on a phone.

Try it in your browser: . There is nothing to install. On a Meta Quest, open the address in its browser and choose Enter VR. More books come from Kiwix's library, right on the page or on the catalogue stand in VR, or from ZIM files on your own device.
It understands three kinds of Kiwix ZIM files especially well:
features: Project Gutenberg (gutenberg2zim): real covers, authors, popularity ranks and the books' own
Wikisource (mwoffliner): every multi-part work — novels, collections, histories; 17,693 in
Wikipedia (mwoffliner): a room of encyclopedia volumes, each holding 1,000 articles in
